_about: A model of a deployment pipeline. stages lists the stages in order. rules lists deployment rules as {stage, item, rule, value}, where rule is "data source", "parameter" or "default lakehouse" (a parameter rule's value is {name: value}). copied_by_deploy says, for each kind of content, whether deploying copies it (true) or it has to be set up in each stage (false).

items.Load sales: Notebook. Its default lakehouse is SalesLH_Dev in Development.
items.Sales model: Semantic model with a parameter Environment ("Development" in Development).
items.SalesLH_Dev: Lakehouse in Development. Test and Production each have their own lakehouse.

needs: Three stages: Development, Test and Production.
In Test, Load sales uses SalesLH_Test, and Sales model's Environment is "Test".
In Production, Load sales uses SalesLH_Prod, and Sales model's Environment is "Production".
